source: shiroprore_exe.exe (Ghidra 12.2). StatusType registries FUN_00ac88e0 (1xx), FUN_00ae09b0 (2xx), FUN_00ace120 (3xx) give each StatusType a slot in a unit status set; table columns are bound to slots where the game writes a record field into a status setter. Records are a 0x38-byte header + one int per column in table order (verified on Card.Tokusei1 at +0x58).
